title: The task
body: In the sorted list **[-4, 1, 3, 8, 11]**, find two numbers that add up to **9**. Start with `left` at -4 and `right` at 11.

title: First sum
body: -4 + 11 = 7, which is too small. A bigger sum needs a bigger left number, so move `left` forward.

title: Second sum
body: 1 + 11 = 12, which is too big. A smaller sum needs a smaller right number, so move `right` back.

title: Why it works
body: Each move discarded a number that could not be in any answer. Every step moves one pointer, so the search is **O(n) time**, and we kept only two indexes: **O(1) space**.
